title: AFOSI officer harassing a UFO whistleblower

tellings.quote: there was proof in this case of it being an AFO SI officer.

plain: In one case, a person harassing a UFO whistleblower was proven to be an officer of AFOSI, the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Air Force's own investigative branch. Matthew Brown, a guest billed as a Pentagon whistleblower, tells Michels this as something a named person told him. If true, it would mean the military itself was going after people who spoke out.
